subject: prd/impl-review
statement: Every process shall record demand and derivation versions, selected review harness and routing policy, prompt/calibration versions, per-pass native profile and top-level context identity, internal round identities, exact reviewed revision, and aggregate identity.
fit_criterion: 100% of dogfood processes carry all fields; context/revision/blindness validators reject omissions, reuse, or mismatch; harvest stratifies by profile, depth, and pass count
